title: more mobs modpack
description: Simple modpack that adds more mobs and optimisation mods and few simple fun mods.
body:
Very Simple modpack that focuses mainly on more mobs, optimisation, and small exploration aspect. (tried avoiding Entity Model Features mods)
please Read Disclaimer(3) 

(right now the modpack is under very early stage, I might make some modification as time goes on. (by modification I mean adding more mobs mods with credits included)

right now there are roughly (130+ mobs without ARR mods) +600 mobs extra from the modpack. (thats counting duplicates and various fish or variants from butterflies, basically I searched the 113 pages under mobs tag on modrith and curseforge 1.21.1 neoforge and picked various mobs mods.) 

The main goal of this modpack is to combine various mobs mods into one single modpack.

(so far various mobs spawn as usual and with shaders on ultra+ resource pack x64 my fps is average 60, however I dont know what the perfomance is for other people and because of such high number of mobs (+600) the game might have unexpected bugs/errors.

make sure you have allocated 6-8GB RAM for this modpack.

![map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nbjuLyIL/images/8c32166103af839217e9e091a099c311a48328e4.png)



Disclaimer(1) 
I (warer) have no connection to any of these people (authors of mods) the mods in the modpack are provided without any changes to the source or code, no modified configs are applied.

(the alex mobs mod used in this modpack is not officially affiliated with the original Alex's Mobs developers)

the modpack would never advertise anything for personal commercial gain, and would be free to download, no warranty is provided.
NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT

if for some reason the author of some mod wants the mod gone from this page just contact me and I will accept your request(if you want more credits contact me and I will include whatever extra credits you want.)



(for Macaw mods under AAR in mod description it says:  "Can I use your mods in my modpack?
A: Yes, just credit us and with a reference to the modrinth page")
